_notes: THE ONBOARDING REWARD, AND NOTHING ELSE EVER LIVES HERE. docs/10 §9 gives the ladder exactly two tutorial rungs for the whole game, so this file is authored once and is not repeated per tier — the same reason data/encounters_tutorial_t1.json sits in ContentDB's DEFAULT_PATHS rather than in tier_paths.

TIER 0, DESPITE THE RUNGS BEING MOUNTED AT TIER 1. docs/09 §12.1's tier column reads "0 = starting gear AND TUTORIAL REWARDS", so the items are tier 0 and the ids begin ITM_T0_. The filename therefore carries no _t1 suffix, which would be a lie about the tier; the encounters file carries one because the rungs really are mounted at tier 1.

SOURCE 'tutorial' IS LOAD-BEARING, NOT A LABEL. sim/core/Loot.gd's non-raid drop pool selects on `it.source == "adventure"`, so a trinket declared here can never enter any rolled pool by construction — which is the hazard docs/10 §9.2 names: the tutorials must not be able to hand out Adventure's Charm of Health (+7 HP) or Charm of Power (+2 Power), the very items the crap trinkets have to be visibly worse than. Putting these two rows in data/items_starting.json instead would have made them source=='start' and just as safe, but would also have made that file's own note — "CANON: no weapon, off-hand or trinket — a Common recruit shows up unarmed" — false.

STATS ARE docs/09 §10.2's, NOT docs/10 §9.2's. docs/09 owns item stat blocks and says so at §10.2; docs/10 §9.2's placeholders name a '+1 Damage' trinket, which cannot be expressed as an item row at all because docs/09 §12.2 restricts `damage` to weapons. §10.2 rules canon's "+1 dps" to be +1 Power, agreeing with docs/11 §14 Q5.

canon: false ON BOTH ROWS, on purpose. §10.2 is 🔷 PROPOSED rather than ✅ CANON: canon asked for "a crap trinket" twice and never gave a stat line, so the numbers are derived and each row carries its derivation in `note`, which sim/content/ContentDB.gd requires of any non-canon item.

WORSE THAN THE WEAKEST ADVENTURE CHARM, BY DESIGN AND BY TEST. +1 Power against Adventure's +2, and +2 HP against Adventure's +7. docs/10 §9.3 requires the skip warning to name what is forfeited, and a tutorial reward that beat the first real rung's would make that warning a lie. tests/unit/test_items_tutorial.gd holds the inequality against the live Adventure rows rather than against a copied number.

THE GRANT IS FIXED AND ONCE-ONLY, and it lives in game/core/GameState.record_attempt, not here: docs/10 §9.3 keeps a resolved tutorial "replayable for gold" while the trinket is gone after the first clear, and that is campaign state rather than a property of the item.
